# Meridian — source record

- **Origin:** the supplied experimental intake already in the Robot Lab experimental registry (CrispStrobe, BSD-3-Clause), reviewed natively before promotion.
- **Adaptations (made at intake, unchanged here):** the licence line points at the packaged licence. Geometry and program are unchanged.
- **Law (`peaucellier-inversor-v1`):** Peaucellier–Lipkin inversor; the passive output Q is the inversion of the crank pin P, OP·OQ = l² − s², and so runs on a straight line at (l² − s²)/(2ρ).
- **Disconnection** (`cell_BQ` removed): one rhombus side; the cell opens and Q is no longer the inversion of P (measured 21.7 mm, loss needs > 2 mm).
